newsitem.title: USA: U.S. says American Radio Systems can buy stations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. says American Radio Systems can buy stations.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department said on Thursday that it allowed American Radio Systems Corp to buy two radio stations in Rochester, N.Y., for a total of four in the city, as long as it sells three other stations.
The Justice Department said it also required that the company end a joint sales agreement with another Rochester radio station.
The Justice Department said it opposed American Radio's initial plan to acquire four Rochester radio stations owned by The Lincoln Group L.P on the grounds it could decrease competition.

The Justice Department said it filed an antitrust suit opposing the original deal, along with a proposed settlement allowing the restructured deal to go forward. The state of New York joined in the case.
